Hi guys! It's Stomach Challo, and today I am in a foreign country where cars are not allowed. I love foreign.
sarla
Okay, it is Matheran. But the red mud is so imported. You can feel the foreign in your shoes.
sarla
The locals travel by horse. Very eco, very European. Also very hungry, so I shared my chikki.
sarla
The toy train is only fifteen minutes away. Fifteen minutes in foreign time. In Bombai time, that is a long weekend.
sarla
The view from Echo Point is amazing. I shouted I love foreign, and the valley agreed. Very polite country.
sarla
That's it for today. Stay hungry, stay foreign. This is Stomach Challo, signing off from West India.
